_why: A document that indexes its own directory is opting into completeness: if it omits a file, the reader has no way to know the list is short, because a short index and a complete one look identical. Coverage is declared here rather than detected, because detection mis-classifies -- traceability-index.md has an index heading and indexes decisions, not the files beside it, and pointing a directory check at it reports defects that are not there. Link resolution needs no manifest and runs over every document.
